✓ Borneo thrush.fact: The Borneo thrush (Turdus poliocephalus seebohmi), also called the mountain blackbird or locally in Dusun as Luhui tana, is a bird in the thrush family. It is a subspecies of the island thrush (Turdus poliocephalus, sensu lato) endemic to the island of Borneo.
